learning_objective: 🎯 We will use our magical minds to draw wild, wonderful things that do not exist, like flying cars or talking animals!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we close our eyes, we can dream up silly things like purple elephants or houses made of candy. Our imagination has no rules!
We can invent completely new creatures! What if we mixed a cat, a bird, and a fish together? Drawing our wild ideas makes us super artists.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Mix-a-Monster
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a friendly monster! Give it three eyes, a dinosaur tail, and fluffy bunny ears. Do not forget to give your funny creature a silly name!

quick_recap: ⭐ Our imagination has no limits, and we can invent brand new colors and shapes.
⭐ There are zero mistakes in make-believe art.
⭐ Dreaming up silly ideas is the best way to become a creative artist!
